premises.text: Electrical lighting drives CO2 emissions, a large share of electricity consumption, and light pollution
premises.evidence_span: Electrical lighting is responsible for 1.7 billion tons of CO2 emissions, is 15% of global electricity consumption, and more than 80% of humans are affected by light pollution

premises.text: Biological light production already works across nature, from glowworms to marine organisms
premises.evidence_span: glowworms, fireflies, and more than 80% of marine organisms know exactly how to produce light biologically

premises.text: A growing, living bioluminescent raw material is created by inserting squid bioluminescence genes into lab-grown bacteria engineered for light efficiency
premises.evidence_span: We created a growing and living raw material, bioluminescence material

premises.text: The liquid biological solution can take any shape or casing and is patented
premises.evidence_span: our light can take basically any shape, any kind of casing, because it's a liquid solution

premises.text: The natural light's wavelength offers health benefits like relaxation and improved cognitive functions
premises.evidence_span: the wavelength that it has also offers health benefits, such as relaxing and improving cognitive functions

premises.text: Two light units are offered: ephemeral Glow Events lasting up to a week and the continuous Pipelight system
premises.evidence_span: The first one is called Glow Events, and it's an ephemeral light to light temporal spaces, and it can light up to one week. The second one is Pipelight. It's a continuous lighting system

premises.text: Pipelight is a waste-fed bioreactor closing the loop: industrial waste in, unlimited light and organic byproducts out
premises.evidence_span: we feed our microbes with waste coming from different kinds of industries

premises.text: Licensing to energy providers who operate the systems is the way to scale, like solar companies did
premises.evidence_span: we are partnering with energy providers. So we license to them our technology, and they operate the system

domains.name: Lighting's environmental problem and nature's proof

value.text: More livable and sustainable cities lit by clean biological light
value.evidence_span: we want to design more livable and sustainable cities for tomorrow

causal_links.evidence_span: in order to reduce the environmental impact
to improve wellness thanks to the quality of this natural light
we have an unlimited light resource and some neutral or valuable 100% organic byproducts
For them, it's a great new business opportunity. And for us, it's an amazing way to scale

notes: D4 is a singleton: the provider-licensing scale model revises independently of the material science and the product forms. Event-driven consumer awareness is treated as part of the go-to-market narrative supporting D4 rather than a separate premise here; the 6,000-unit sales figure and Eiffel Tower installation are traction per 4.2. The any-shape/patent claim is split from the core material premise (P4) because the liquid form factor could fail while the engineered organism still glows. 'Bioluminescence will replace electric lighting' is vision framing, uncoded per v1.3.2 clarification 4. No explicit premise-prerequisite asserted.
